name: Ginger (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Ginger (Zingiber officinale) [Herbs and Spices] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 169231 (Ginger root, raw; SR Legacy NDB 11216) - proximates, sugars, amino acids, vitamins, minerals, fatty acids
Ghasemzadeh et al. 2018, 'Changes in Nutritional Metabolites of Young Ginger in Response to Elevated CO2', PMC6270952 - rhizome free-sugar (sucrose/glucose/fructose) ratios
Otunola/Onwuka 2007, 'Nutrient and Anti-nutrient Constituents of Ginger', Int. J. Biol. Chem. doi:10.3923/ijbc.2007.38.46 - oxalate and mineral data (dried basis)
Chemical & antioxidant parameters of dried forms of ginger rhizomes, Ind. Crops Prod. S0926669015303538 - HPLC identification of oxalic/malic/citric/fumaric organic acids
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy sources for growth are STARCH (~14 g/100g) and the free sugars (sucrose > glucose > fructose, ~1.7 g/100g total); the previously-missing organic acids (oxalic dominant, plus malic/citric/fumaric) add a secondary acid pool. Individual free-sugar values were obtained by splitting the USDA-measured total sugars by literature rhizome ratios (variety- and processing-dependent, so medium confidence on the sugar split); all other quantities are direct USDA measurements. Organic-a
curation_added: Individual free sugars with amounts (sucrose 0.96, glucose 0.50, fructose 0.25 g/100g)
Starch (~14 g/100g, the dominant carbohydrate) by difference
Organic acids: oxalic (dominant, ~0.15 g/100g), malic, citric, fumaric (present, HPLC-confirmed)
Quantitative amino-acid profile (18 amino acids, USDA)
Linoleic and alpha-linolenic acid amounts; SFA/MUFA totals

curation_removed.name: 17alpha-ethynylestradiol
curation_removed.reason: Synthetic contraceptive estrogen; biologically impossible in a plant rhizome. FooDB predicted/contaminant artifact.

curation_removed.name: epsilon-Polylysine
curation_removed.reason: Bacterial-fermentation food preservative (Streptomyces product), not a ginger constituent; FooDB contaminant/misassignment.

curation_removed.name: Aluminum
curation_removed.reason: Non-nutritive trace contaminant element, not a growth nutrient.

curation_removed.name: Silicon
curation_removed.reason: Structural silica; not a microbial growth nutrient.

curation_removed.name: Nickel
curation_removed.reason: Non-essential ultratrace contaminant; not quantified as a ginger nutrient.

curation_removed.name: Co2+
curation_removed.reason: Cobalt ultratrace; plants supply no B12, so free Co2+ here is non-nutritive trace/contaminant noise.

curation_removed.name: Chromium
curation_removed.reason: Ultratrace, non-established plant/microbial macro-nutrient; drop as non-nutritive trace.

curation_removed.name: (±)-erythro-Isoleucine
curation_removed.reason: Predicted stereoisomer artifact duplicating L-isoleucine already in the profile.

curation_removed.name: Albumin
curation_removed.reason: Generic protein class, not a discrete metabolite; subsumed by total protein / amino-acid profile.

curation_removed.name: Prolamine
curation_removed.reason: Generic storage-protein class; subsumed by total protein / amino-acid profile.

curation_removed.name: Retinol / Beta-Carotene / Vitamin A
curation_removed.reason: USDA reports vitamin A = 0 IU and beta-carotene ~0 in raw ginger; effectively absent, drop from the quantitative medium (trace at most).

composition_provenance.definition: sourced = the cited source states this component; derived = the pipeline supplied it. Classification table: tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv.

components.name: D-glucose
components.evidence_source: USDA FDC 169231 (total sugars 1.70 g) apportioned by rhizome free-sugar ratio in Ghasemzadeh 2018 PMC6270952 (sucrose 33.5 / glucose 17.4 / fructose 8.6 mg/g DW)

components.name: starch
components.evidence_source: USDA FDC 169231 by difference (carbohydrate 17.77 - total sugars 1.70 - fiber 2.00)

components.name: oxalic acid
components.evidence_source: Onwuka/Otunola-type analyses: 4.55 mg/g DW oxalate (scialert ijbc.2007.38.46) ~= 0.10 g/100g fresh; up to 0.23 g/100g reported (Adom/AHM 2022)

components.name: malic acid
components.evidence_source: HPLC identification in ginger rhizome (Sci Total/J Ethnopharmacol S0926669015303538; researchgate 228476601)

components.name: citric acid
components.evidence_source: HPLC identification (S0926669015303538); ~2.1% w/w reported in a dried ginger extract

basis: per 100 g fresh weight (raw ginger rhizome, Zingiber officinale)

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
